subject: prd/contract-gate
statement: If at planning entry a feature has a PRD but no live serving designs at all, then the system shall bounce `incomplete` (every Must unserved), naming the uncovered Musts — never treat "no designs" as vacuously clean
fit_criterion: the no-designs fixture bounces `incomplete` at planning entry; the same feature on a contract-doc PR reports coverage advisory (FR-9), not blocking
